Messages.Body:
On VTES-L, Davey Bonnevalle wrote:
> 1. Is damage done by Zombie/Wolf Companion, Carrion Crows considered to
> be delt by the vampire (to add to the damage to play Disarm, Pulled
> Fangs)?

No:

Damage (Combat)

* Damage is only considered to have come from a minion if the damage is
from a strike or if an effect specifically states that the damage is
dealt by the minion. Damage from other effects is considered
"environmental," and has no particular source. [RTR 970630]

> 2. Can u untap a vampire with Second Tradition and then play an auspex
> interceptcard (for the prevent/maneuver) or do you have to use the +2
> intercept from the Second Tradition?

Playing 2nd tradtion increases the vampire's intercept by 2. It is
not optional.

> 3. What deck do u (Scot) prefer to play with?

The question is not really suited to me - I like to play decks I haven't
played before.
